subject: Post-demo: confirming economic sponsor + procurement/security path
messages:
From: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>
To: Sarah Chen <sarah.chen@nimbushealth.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>, Dev Patel <dev.patel@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 6 Jul 2027 16:14:00 -0700
Subject: Post-demo: confirming economic sponsor + procurement/security path

Hi Sarah — thanks again for your time today. Quick recap and proposed next steps from our side: 

- Observation: the team is most focused on predictable latency and an isolated VPC deployment for PHI-safe inference. You mentioned budget is in the clinical platform line item.
- Desired outcome: a pilot (3–4 week) with a small dedicated instance, scoped to EHR redaction + structured output.

Can you confirm two pieces so we can move the MAP forward: 
1) Economic sponsor / budget owner: who signs the P.O. for projects under the clinical platform? (title/name/contact)
2) Procurement & security gate: who should we send the SOC2/SLA and the legal terms to? We can prepare a one-page evidence pack and short SSO/KMS notes.

Attached is a draft mutual action plan and our security summary (Redwood_Security_Sheet.pdf). If you prefer, we can loop in procurement on the next call — otherwise a 15–20m intro with the budget owner + procurement would help us align timelines.

Proposed next dates for a procurement intro: Thu 7/8 or Mon 7/12 morning PT. What works for you?

Thanks — looking forward to making the pilot low friction.

Best,
Marcus
Director, Solutions 
Redwood Inference
[Attachment: MutualActionPlan-v1.xlsx (spreadsheet)]
[Attachment: Redwood_Security_Sheet.pdf (pdf)]

From: Sarah Chen <sarah.chen@nimbushealth.com>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 6 Jul 2027 18:07:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Post-demo: confirming economic sponsor + procurement/security path

Thanks Marcus — appreciate the clear recap. Short answers: 

1) Economic sponsor: that would be Priya Shah, VP Clinical Platforms (cc'ed on this thread — I've also included Alex Turner in procurement). Priya owns the clinical platform budget and signs POs over $25k.
2) Procurement & security: Alex Turner (procurement) handles commercial terms; Priya will route security artifacts to our InfoSec contact, but feel free to send the SOC2 and a KMS/SSO summary directly to Alex and Priya.

I'll plan to introduce Priya and Alex on a quick call. Thu 7/8 AM PT works for me.

—Sarah
Director, Product 
Nimbus Health

Subject: Intro + MAP: pilot scope and evidence pack for Nimbus Health

Priya / Alex — thanks for joining us. Sarah briefed me on the goals; I'll keep this tight: 

Pilot ask (summary): 3–4 week dedicated instance to validate PHI-safe redaction + structured output for 1 clinical workflow. Minimal data footprint, encrypted at rest, customer-managed keys.

What we can provide immediately: 
- Pilot SOW (one-page) and estimated committed capacity (tokens/hour)
- Security pack: SOC2 summary, data flow diagram, SSO/KMS integration notes (attached PDF)
- Quick POC plan and success criteria (latency <300ms p50 for 512-token seq / sample quality targets)

Open questions for you: 
- Priya: is there a preferred PO approver (title/email) we should list on the MAP for routing?
- Alex: any procurement template or redline process we should follow? Do you require a redline before the pilot or can we proceed on a short-term agreement + later commercial contract?

If helpful, I've uploaded a draft MAP and security sheet to this Drive link: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1aBcDeF-MAP (same files attached). Suggested call: Thu 7/8 9:30–10:00 AM PT — I can host and walk the procurement/security asks.

Marcus
Director, Solutions
Redwood Inference
[Attachment: Redwood_Security_Sheet.pdf (pdf)]

From: Dev Patel <dev.patel@redwood.ai>
To: Priya Shah <priya.shah@nimbushealth.com>, Alex Turner <alex.turner@nimbushealth.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>, Sarah Chen <sarah.chen@nimbushealth.com>
Date: Wed, 7 Jul 2027 09:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Intro + MAP: pilot scope and evidence pack for Nimbus Health

Thanks all — quick technical note from our side: 

- We can provision a private VPC pilot with customer-managed KMS and SAML-based SSO within 48–72 hours of a signed short-term order.
- We'll scope the pilot to a single model variant that supports quantized inference to reduce cost.

I've attached a short tech checklist that maps the security artifacts Nimbus asked for to the document we provide. If procurement is comfortable with a short-term commitment (60 days), we can start immediately and iterate on the master agreement in parallel.

Happy to jump on Thu 7/8 9:30 AM PT and walk through the checklist.

—Dev
Senior Solutions Engineer
Redwood Inference
